concerns.text: FR-001 (and many other FRs) reference 'US-1' (e.g., "See US-1") but the document only defines 'User Story 1' without assigning an ID like US-1. This creates an unresolved cross‑reference, breaking traceability between requirements and user stories.

Inconsistent terminology: the user stories are introduced as 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', etc., yet later the spec refers to them as 'US-1', 'US-2', etc. The same concept should be named consistently throughout the document.
